about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a passionate developer currently studying Mobile Software Development at FH Joanneum. My journey in web development started with a deep interest in creating user-friendly and visually appealing applications.
about.paragraph2: I have experience with modern web technologies like React, Next.js, TypeScript, and various backend solutions. I focus on creating responsive, accessible, and performant web applications.
about.description: I am a dedicated Mobile Software Development student at FH Joanneum with a passion for web and app development. I enjoy creating responsive applications with robust functionality—from building full-stack features and database integration to implementing APIs and routing systems.

smartKasse.title: SmartKassa
smartKasse.description: RKSV-compliant cash register and ride management system for Austrian taxi companies. With JWT authentication, receipt generation, and a native mobile app via Capacitor.
smartKasse.details: SmartKassa helps Austrian taxi companies stay compliant while keeping day-to-day work simple. Drivers manage their rides and issue receipts from a native mobile app, while the backend handles authentication and data storage.

socialMediaApp.title: Social Media App with AI
socialMediaApp.description: Interactive social platform with real-time posts, comments, nested replies, and live like updates. Features authentication and guest login
socialMediaApp.details: A social platform built around real-time interaction. Users can post, comment, reply in nested threads and see likes update live, with a guest login for quickly trying it out.

issueTracker.title: Issue Tracker
issueTracker.description: Project management tool for tracking issues, bugs, and tasks with status management, priority levels, and user assignments
issueTracker.details: A project management tool for keeping track of work. Issues move through statuses, carry priorities and can be assigned to users, so a team always knows what is open and who owns it.

blink.title: Blink
blink.description: Blink is a native Android app built for the "Mobile Platforms" course (Exercise 4) at FH JOANNEUM. It demonstrates a modern user interface built with Jetpack Compose and following the principles of Material Design 3.
blink.details: A minimalist social media client that lets users write status updates and navigate between Home, Search and Account. It uses Firebase as its backend and Cloudinary to upload and store pictures, with the focus on a clean Compose implementation and UI logic.
features: Written entirely in Jetpack Compose (no XML)
Picture upload and storage with Cloudinary
MVVM-style separation of view and model

restaurant.title: Taverna Luna
restaurant.description: Restaurant website with an online menu and table reservations, backed by a RESTful API that manages reservations, tables and customers.
restaurant.details: A full-stack restaurant management system split into a React frontend and a Spring Boot backend. Guests can browse the menu and reserve a table, while the REST API stores reservations, tables and customers in a PostgreSQL database.
features: Table reservation with form and confirmation page
RESTful API for reservations, tables and customers
Spring Data JPA with a PostgreSQL database
Layered backend with controllers, services, repositories and DTOs
